name: aurora-bay
description: Aurora Bay - a 3D online multiplayer property trading board game

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix backend & npm run dev --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.build:bundled: npm run build:bundled --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
